## Review checklist

- [ ] The acceptance criteria are met and unrelated changes are excluded.
- [ ] No duplicate owner, obsolete path, or unexplained dependency was added.
- [ ] Account identity, stale results, secrets, and cleanup were checked where relevant.
- [ ] Authentication/PCG selection requirements are preserved without claiming unverified retention.
- [ ] Relevant tests and test/typecheck/zero-warning lint results are recorded.
- [ ] Diagnostics were not hidden; no rule downgrade, suppression, or CI bypass was introduced.
- [ ] Hosted execution and manual checks are distinguished from local evidence.
- [ ] Documentation matches the actual tree and remaining acceptance gaps are explicit.
